# docs-policy-kit

> Config-driven docs-policy engine: derived-copy drift gates,
> allowlisted publication with secret-scanned gates, ruling guards, and
> a docs audit. Every publication claim becomes an exit code.

The AI Engineering Control Plane (AI ECP) family: independent kit repos
run by rules an agent can execute. Members:

- [repo-guards](https://github.com/kylebrodeur/repo-guards): repo and
  release discipline gates
- [actions-runner](https://github.com/kylebrodeur/actions-runner): the
  `arun` config-driven local agent-pipeline runner
- [ecp-toolkit](https://github.com/kylebrodeur/ecp-toolkit): the `ecp`
  control-plane CLI (PLANNED)
- [omp-rpc-cli](https://github.com/kylebrodeur/omp-rpc-cli): persistent
  `omp` RPC sessions

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the boundary, stated as rules an agent obeys
- [docs/quickstart.md](docs/quickstart.md): from nothing to gated docs
- [docs/how-to.md](docs/how-to.md): the tasks you repeat
- [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md): the full command surface, every
  error string and its fix, and the recovery procedures
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, tests, and opening a change
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting
- [skills/docs-policy-kit/SKILL.md](skills/docs-policy-kit/SKILL.md):
  the skill for agents operating the engine
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): Apache-2.0

## Status

Consolidated, tested, not yet published to a package registry; install
from a checkout or a vendored copy. Facts checked 2026-10-22.
